body: VAERS fixture: adolescent male received COVID-19 mRNA vaccine. Two days later chest pain and elevated troponin consistent with myocarditis. Recovered after supportive care.
VAERS fixture: adult received seasonal influenza vaccine. Progressive ascending weakness and areflexia; Guillain-Barre syndrome diagnosed. Hospitalized.
VAERS fixture: toddler received MMR vaccine. Fever and brief febrile seizure within 24 hours. No lasting sequelae noted.
VAERS fixture: adult with known allergy history developed anaphylaxis minutes after COVID-19 mRNA vaccine. Epinephrine administered; recovered.
VAERS fixture: adolescent female experienced syncope shortly after HPV vaccine administration. Observed and discharged.
VAERS fixture: older adult reported severe injection site reaction and fever after recombinant shingles vaccine.
VAERS fixture: young adult male; COVID-19 mRNA vaccine dose 2; myocarditis with chest pain and abnormal ECG. Improved with NSAIDs.
VAERS fixture: pregnant patient received Tdap; significant arm pain and swelling at injection site for several days.
